mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by >0.3pp but SPX 20-day returns remain positive in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment (UNRATE) show improving trends, it indicates a strong labor market, boosting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE improve but SPX 20-day returns are negative >30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing, which stimulates equity markets and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS drops below 0.1 but SPX 5-day returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stronger economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth is positive but SPX 60-day returns are negative >35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate investment (RSAFS) increases and inflation (CPIAUCSL) decreases, it indicates a balanced demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS rises and CPIAUCSL falls but SPX 20-day returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which positively impacts related sectors and leads to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by >5% but SPX 60-day returns are negative >35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid growth in real estate investment (RSAFS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS grows and UNRATE is low but SPX 20-day returns are negative >40% of the time.
